The ophthalmologist was kind, knowledgeable, and very helpful. However, be prepared to be irritated by the reception staff. I went for an eye exam and wanted a document for reference before getting LASIK surgery. When paying, I asked if they provided a copy of the exam results. They asked, "What do you want? A medical certificate or something?" They then said, "I'll give it to the doctor myself." They asked me to wait. I saw the doctor was examining another patient and thought he might go for lunch, so I asked again if I could come back to pick it up. They said the shop was closing and I had to wait. If it were me, I would have used a more polite tone, saying, "Please wait a moment, the doctor is almost finished. You can receive it then." I was starting to get annoyed.
